verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official, agent-oriented Link CLI that issues one-time-use credentials (virtual card, LPT, SPT) and reads permissioned financial data. It exposes `link-cli --llms-full` for agent-readable docs, and the probe confirms it is published on npm (@stripe/link-cli 0.19.2) with source at github.com/stripe/link-cli. Coding agents can also use the Stripe CLI (`stripe sandbox create`) to provision a sandbox without registering, and `mppx validate` checks MPP integrations; missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of real-world CLI usage.
